sentences.en: It's May 1864 and we are in London.
sentences.zh: 那是1864年5月，我们在伦敦。

sentences.en: Beating heart of a mighty empire.
sentences.zh: 一个强大帝国的跳动心脏。

sentences.en: A city of railways and telegraphs and smoke.
sentences.zh: 一座充满铁路、电报和烟雾的城市。

sentences.en: The crucible of modernity.
sentences.zh: 现代性的熔炉。

sentences.en: Absolutely tremendous days.
sentences.zh: 绝对了不起的日子。

sentences.en: And Dominic, in Whitehall, the foreign secretary, Lord Russell, is studying a scribbled pencil note which has been smuggled to the Red Sea coast and then carried by ship to London.
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，在白厅，外交大臣罗素勋爵正在研究一张潦草的铅笔便条，它被走私到红海海岸，然后乘船运往伦敦。

sentences.en: And it reads, myself, Stern, Rosenthal, Cairns, Bardwell, McCravey and McKilvey are all chained here.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，我和斯特恩、罗森塔尔、凯恩斯、巴德韦尔、麦克雷维以及麦基尔维都被锁在这里。

sentences.en: Flad, Steger, Brandis and Cornelius sent to Gafat to work for the king.
sentences.zh: 弗拉德、斯特格尔、布兰迪斯和科内利乌斯被派往加法特为国王效劳。

sentences.en: No release until civil answer to king's letter arrives and it's signed CDC Charles Duncan Cameron.
sentences.zh: 在收到对国王信件的文明答复之前不得释放，并由 CDC查尔斯·邓肯·卡梅隆签署。

sentences.en: And Lord Russell, the foreign secretary, asked his officials, oh my God, are there any letters from the king of Abyssinia that we have neglected to answer?
sentences.zh: 然后外交大臣罗素勋爵问他的官员，天哪，我们有没有忽视回复任何来自阿比西尼亚国王的信件？

sentences.en: And what's the answer, Dominic?
sentences.zh: 答案是什么，多米尼克？

sentences.en: Well, they go digging into their files and guess what?
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们去翻找他们的档案，你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: There is.
sentences.zh: 还真有。

sentences.en: This is Theodros' original letter that he had sent with Cameron.
sentences.zh: 这是提奥多罗斯当年交给卡梅隆的那封原信。

sentences.en: And what had happened to this letter?
sentences.zh: 这封信经历了什么呢？

sentences.en: It's an interesting story, actually, a revealing story.
sentences.zh: 其实是个有趣的故事，一个颇具启示性的故事。

sentences.en: It had gone across the Red Sea to Aden and then went from Aden to Bombay and then it went back across the Indian Ocean to Suez and then it went across the desert to Alexandria and by ship from Alexandria to Marseille and then by train to the Channel Coast and then by boat across the coast and then by train to London.
sentences.zh: 它穿过红海到达亚丁，然后从亚丁到孟买，接着横渡印度洋回到苏伊士，然后穿过沙漠到达亚历山大，从亚历山大乘船到马赛，然后坐火车到海峡海岸，再乘船过海，最后坐火车到伦敦。

sentences.en: So the journey of this letter is a remarkable story.
sentences.zh: 所以这封信的旅程是一个非凡的故事。

sentences.en: It tells you everything you need to know about the kind of globalized world of the British Empire.
sentences.zh: 它告诉你所有你需要了解的关于大英帝国那种全球化世界的事情。

sentences.en: But when it finally got to the foreign office, the officials didn't know what to do with it.
sentences.zh: 但当它最终到达外交部时，官员们不知道该拿它怎么办。

sentences.en: They just saw it as weird and a sort of distraction from bigger issues.
sentences.zh: 他们只觉得这很怪异，算是一种对更大问题的干扰。

sentences.en: And one of them wrote on Cameron's accompanying note, we can expect no advantage from meddling with the politics of Abyssinia.
sentences.zh: 其中一人在卡梅隆的随附便条上写道，插手阿比西尼亚的政治不会给我们带来任何好处。

sentences.en: So the British actually do not want to intervene in Abyssinia.
sentences.zh: 所以英国人其实并不想干预阿比西尼亚。

sentences.en: They're not interested in it.
sentences.zh: 他们对此不感兴趣。

sentences.en: They forwarded the letter to the India office.
sentences.zh: 他们把信转给印度事务部。

sentences.en: It was filed away in the India office and people forgot all about it.
sentences.zh: 它被归档在印度事务部，人们把它忘得精光。

sentences.en: Anyway, now, 18 months on, they dig it out again.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，现在，18个月过去了，他们又把它挖了出来。

sentences.en: And they draft a reply from Queen Victoria, a reply which they hope, and I quote, will tempt the savage to let our people go.
sentences.zh: 他们起草了一封维多利亚女王的回信，他们希望这封信——我引用一下——能引诱野蛮人放了我们的人。

sentences.en: It's addressed to our good friend Teodros, king of Abyssinia.
sentences.zh: 收信人是我们的好朋友阿比西尼亚国王提奥多罗斯。

sentences.en: And Victoria, she says, I've heard that you've detained some of our people.
sentences.zh: 维多利亚女王说，我听说你扣押了我们的一些人。

sentences.en: And she says that your majesty can give no better proof of the sincerity of the sentiments which you profess towards us than by dismissing our servant and any other Europeans who may desire it from your court and by affording them every assistance and protection on their journey.
sentences.zh: 她表示，陛下若能解除我们仆人及任何其他愿离去的欧洲人之职务，并为他们的旅程提供一切协助和保护，便是对您向我们所表达的真挚情感的最好证明。

sentences.en: Is that your Queen Victoria voice?
sentences.zh: 那是你的维多利亚女王配音吗？

sentences.en: That's Queen Victoria's voice.
sentences.zh: 那是维多利亚女王的声音。

sentences.en: Audio archive.
sentences.zh: 音频档案。

sentences.en: And that's signed, Victoria R.
sentences.zh: 署名是维多利亚 R。

sentences.en: Balmoral, 26th of May, 1864.
sentences.zh: 巴尔莫勒尔，1864年5月26日。

sentences.en: And they say, well, obviously, we'll have to send somebody with this letter to, you know, persuade Teodros to accept it as a sign of our friendship.
sentences.zh: 他们说，很显然，我们得派一个人带着这封信去，你知道的，说服提奥多罗斯接受它作为我们友谊的象征。

sentences.en: And the reason they're doing this is not particularly that they're worried about the missionaries.
sentences.zh: 他们这么做并不是特别担心那些传教士。

sentences.en: I question how much they really care about the missionaries, to be brutally honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我怀疑他们究竟有多在乎那些传教士。

sentences.en: What they really care about is the French, of course.
sentences.zh: 他们真正关心的是法国人，当然。

sentences.en: So this is the point when Suez Canal mania is at its height.
sentences.zh: 所以这是苏伊士运河狂热达到顶峰的时候。

sentences.en: They are very anxious that if they alienate Teodros, he will jump into bed with Paris.
sentences.zh: 他们非常担心如果疏远了提奥多罗斯，他会跟巴黎混在一起。

sentences.en: The French will end up controlling the Red Sea coaSt.
sentences.zh: 法国人最终会控制红海海岸。

sentences.en: And that would mean the French would control the route between Suez and India.
sentences.zh: 那将意味着法国人控制苏伊士和印度之间的路线。

sentences.en: And we cannot have that.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不能允许这种事发生。

sentences.en: So they choose somebody to take this letter and to assure Teodros of Britain's friendship.
sentences.zh: 所以他们挑选了一个人去送这封信，并向提奥多罗斯保证英国的友谊。

sentences.en: And the guy they choose is a really, really remarkable man called Hormuzd Rassam.
sentences.zh: 他们选中这家伙是一个非常非常了不起的人，名叫霍姆兹·拉萨姆。

sentences.en: And, Tom, you should like him on all kinds of levels.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，你在各个层面上都应该会喜欢他。

sentences.en: Well, he's born in Mosul, wasn't he?
sentences.zh: 嗯，他出生在摩苏尔，对吧？

sentences.en: Which is the home of Omar Mohammed, who did an extraordinary bonus for us a couple of weeks back.
sentences.zh: 那正是奥马尔·穆罕默德的故乡，他几周前为我们做了一期非凡的特别节目。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And he's an ethnic Assyrian, Hormuzd Rassam, and an archaeologiSt.
sentences.zh: 霍姆兹·拉萨姆是有着亚述血统的民族，还是一位考古学家。

sentences.en: I know you love a bit of archaeology.
sentences.zh: 我知道你喜欢一点考古学。

sentences.en: He did some digging at Nimrud and at Nineveh.
sentences.zh: 他在尼姆鲁德和尼尼微做过一些发掘工作。

sentences.en: Well, Nineveh is basically Mosul, so just right on his doorstep.
sentences.zh: 嗯，尼尼微基本上就是摩苏尔，所以就在他家门口。

sentences.en: And now I know as well, you love the British Museum.
sentences.zh: 现在我也知道，你喜欢大英博物馆。

sentences.en: And this guy, Rassam, did a lot of work for the British Museum.
sentences.zh: 这家伙拉萨姆为大英博物馆做过很多工作。

sentences.en: He discovered the Palace of Ashurbanipal, which you will know far more about than I do.
sentences.zh: 他发现了亚述巴尼拔宫，你对它的了解肯定比我多得多。

sentences.en: And he was instrumental in discovering the Epic of Gilgamesh, the tablets.
sentences.zh: 他在发现《吉尔伽美什史诗》泥板方面发挥了关键作用。

sentences.en: We must do an episode on that.
sentences.zh: 我们必须做一期关于那个的节目。

sentences.en: Yeah, the Epic of Gilgamesh would be brilliant.
sentences.zh: 对，《吉尔伽美什史诗》会很精彩。

sentences.en: Anyway, so this guy, Rassam, there should be a statue of him at the British Museum.
sentences.zh: 总之，这家伙拉萨姆，大英博物馆里真该给他立个雕像。

sentences.en: He was such a tremendous man.
sentences.zh: 他是个如此了不起的人。

sentences.en: He travelled to England.
sentences.zh: 他去了英国。

sentences.en: He went to Magdalen College, Oxford.
sentences.zh: 他去了牛津大学莫德林学院。

sentences.en: He converted to Protestantism when he was at Oxford.
sentences.zh: 他在牛津时改信了新教。

sentences.en: He became a massive Anglophile.
sentences.zh: 他成了一个狂热的亲英派。

sentences.en: He's a man who I reckon would wear a tweed suit to bed.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他是个连睡觉都会穿着花呢西装的人。

sentences.en: In the 40-degree heat of Ethiopia.
sentences.zh: 在埃塞俄比亚40度的高温下。

sentences.en: Unquestionably.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: And the Foreign Office had employed him as their political agent in Aden.
sentences.zh: 外交部曾雇用他担任他们在亚丁的政治特工。

sentences.en: You're right.
sentences.zh: 你说得对。

sentences.en: He's a tremendous man.
sentences.zh: 他是个了不起的人。

sentences.en: And Rassam is now in his mid-30s.
sentences.zh: 拉萨姆现在三十岁出头。

sentences.en: Everyone says he's brilliant.
sentences.zh: 每个人都说他才华横溢。

sentences.en: Everyone says this guy is the absolute business.
sentences.zh: 每个人都说这家伙绝对是个能干人。

sentences.en: He's pleasant.
sentences.zh: 他很随和。

sentences.en: He's polite.
sentences.zh: 他很有礼貌。

sentences.en: He's really good at archaeology.
sentences.zh: 他考古真的很有一套。

sentences.en: He knows loads about Assyria.
sentences.zh: 他对亚述了如指掌。

sentences.en: He loves digging.
sentences.zh: 他热爱发掘。

sentences.en: He loves Britain.
sentences.zh: 他热爱英国。

sentences.en: He's great.
sentences.zh: 他太棒了。

sentences.en: There's literally nothing not to like.
sentences.zh: 简直没有什么可挑剔的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: The only person who doesn't like him, actually, is Sir Harry Flashman, who found him oily in his memoir, Flashman on the March.
sentences.zh: 唯一不喜欢他的人其实是哈里·弗莱什曼爵士，他在回忆录《进军的弗莱什曼》中觉得他油腔滑调。

sentences.en: But every writer who's written about this says Rassam is fantastic.
sentences.zh: 但所有写过这段历史的作家都说拉萨姆棒极了。

sentences.en: Good judgment, sensible, calm, level-headed, all of this.
sentences.zh: 判断力好，明智，冷静，头脑清醒，诸如此类。

sentences.en: Rassam arrives on the Red Sea coast at Massawa in July 1864 with two blokes, a doctor called Henry Blanc and Lieutenant Prido of the Bombay Staff Corps.
sentences.zh: 拉萨姆于1864年7月带着两个人抵达红海海岸的马萨瓦，一个是名叫亨利·布兰克的医生，另一个是孟买参谋部的普里多中尉。

sentences.en: They've come as his assistants.
sentences.zh: 他们是作为他的助手来的。

sentences.en: Both with suspiciously French names.
sentences.zh: 两人的名字都带有可疑的法国色彩。

sentences.en: Well, here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，事情是这样的。

sentences.en: There are some writers who say the British sent Rassam, Blanc, and Prido deliberately because if everything went wrong and they got into trouble, the British wouldn't care.
sentences.zh: 有些作家说，英国人故意派拉萨姆、布兰克和普里多去，是因为如果一切搞砸了他们陷入麻烦，英国人根本不在乎。

sentences.en: So it would play well with the newspapers because they all had foreign names.
sentences.zh: 所以这在报纸上会很受欢迎，因为他们都有外国名字。

sentences.en: That's the cunning, you see?
sentences.zh: 这就是狡猾之处，明白吗？

sentences.en: That's the cunning of the British Foreign Office.
sentences.zh: 这就是英国外交部的狡猾之处。

sentences.en: That is the animal cunning of the British Foreign Office that has slightly gone missing recently.
sentences.zh: 这就是英国外交部那股最近有点失传的动物般的狡猾。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: We used to be a real country.
sentences.zh: 我们过去可是一个真正的国家。

sentences.en: So anyway, Rassam sends a letter inland to Teodros and he waits.
sentences.zh: 所以无论如何，拉萨姆向内陆给提奥多罗斯寄了一封信，然后等待着。

sentences.en: And two months go by and all the time he's trying to get intel on the guy he's got to do business with.
sentences.zh: 两个月过去了，他一直在努力搜集他要打交道的那家伙的情报。

sentences.en: So Teodros' reputation now is very bad.
sentences.zh: 所以提奥多罗斯现在的名声非常糟糕。

sentences.en: One trader says to him, he is the scourge of humanity, the archenemy of humankind.
sentences.zh: 一个商人对他说，他是人类的灾难，全人类的死敌。

sentences.en: But the local ruler on the Red Sea coast says, no, that's not true at all.
sentences.zh: 但红海海岸的当地统治者却说，不，完全不是这样的。

sentences.en: He says he's actually a very kind man.
sentences.zh: 他说他其实是一个非常善良的人。

sentences.en: He's just been led astray by the natural bloodlust of the Abyssinian people.
sentences.zh: 他只是被阿比西尼亚人民天生的嗜血本性带歪了。

sentences.en: And then the local ruler adds the ominous remark, of course, he's also insane.
sentences.zh: 接着这位当地统治者补充了一个不祥的评价，当然，他也疯了。

sentences.en: So they keep waiting.
sentences.zh: 所以他们继续等待。

sentences.en: It's incredibly hot.
sentences.zh: 天气热得难以置信。

sentences.en: So they have to camp outside in what was once Plowden's Garden.
sentences.zh: 因此他们不得不在曾经是普洛登花园的地方扎营。

sentences.en: There's cholera, there's a famine.
sentences.zh: 那里有霍乱，还有饥荒。

sentences.en: It's all terrible.
sentences.zh: 一切都糟透了。

sentences.en: They're waiting for news.
sentences.zh: 他们在等待消息。

sentences.en: And finally, letters arrive not from Teodros, but from the hostages themselves.
sentences.zh: 最后，信件终于到了，不是来自提奥多罗斯，而是来自人质本身。

sentences.en: So these are Stern, Rosenthal, Cameron and the other missionaries.
sentences.zh: 也就是斯特恩、罗森塔尔、卡梅隆和其他传教士。

sentences.en: Now, a lot of time has passed.
sentences.zh: 现在，已经过去很长时间了。

sentences.en: They have been in captivity now for 18 months and their conditions are sub-ideal.
sentences.zh: 他们已经被囚禁了18个月，他们的状况远谈不上理想。

sentences.en: They've been kept chained up initially in the royal camp.
sentences.zh: 他们最初被关在皇家营地的铁链中。

sentences.en: They didn't see much of Teodros.
sentences.zh: 他们不怎么见到提奥多罗斯。

sentences.en: Occasionally, when he'd been drinking, he would come into the tents where they were chained up in a massive rage.
sentences.zh: 偶尔当他喝了酒的时候，他会怒气冲冲地走进他们被锁着的帐篷里。

sentences.en: He would have them bound in very tight cords, sort of like ropes.
sentences.zh: 他会让他们被非常紧的绳索捆绑起来。

sentences.en: And then he would have them doused in cold water, which seems a bit mean.
sentences.zh: 然后他会让人往他们身上泼冷水，这似乎有点刻薄。

sentences.en: Well, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这很难说。

sentences.en: It depends how hot it is.
sentences.zh: 这得看当时有多热。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You'd probably steam, would you?
sentences.zh: 你大概会冒蒸汽吧？

sentences.en: You're really hot.
sentences.zh: 你真的很热。

sentences.en: You might steam.
sentences.zh: 你可能会冒蒸汽。

sentences.en: No one wants that.
sentences.zh: 谁都不想这样。

sentences.en: From your heart.
sentences.zh: 发自内心地。

sentences.en: He's obsessed with the idea that they have local collaborators.
sentences.zh: 他坚信这些人有当地的同谋。

sentences.en: The time goes by.
sentences.zh: 时间一天天过去。

sentences.en: Their clothes are rags.
sentences.zh: 他们的衣服都成了破布烂衫。

sentences.en: They're living on a handful of dried peas.
sentences.zh: 他们仅靠一把干豌豆维持生计。

sentences.en: It rains in the summer.
sentences.zh: 夏天会下雨。

sentences.en: They're very sodden.
sentences.zh: 他们浑身湿透。

sentences.en: They're miserable.
sentences.zh: 他们苦不堪言。

sentences.en: They're very ill.
sentences.zh: 他们病得很重。

sentences.en: And at the end of 1864, they are dragged out of their tents to join this long column of Teodros' prisoners.
sentences.zh: 到了1864年底，他们被从帐篷里拖出来，加入了这条由特沃德罗斯的囚犯组成的长长队伍。

sentences.en: So these are captured rebels, disgraced officials, common criminals.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些人都是被俘的叛军、失势的官员和普通刑事犯。

sentences.en: They're marched out across the highlands for seven days.
sentences.zh: 他们被迫在高原上行军七天。

sentences.en: And after a week, they're absolutely exhausted.
sentences.zh: 一周后，他们已经精疲力竭。

sentences.en: And then finally, they see ahead their destination, the towering cliffs of Magdala, which is Teodros' mountain citadel.
sentences.zh: 最后，他们终于看到了前方的前方目的地——马格达拉高耸的悬崖，那是特沃德罗斯的山区城堡。

sentences.en: And this is his favorite headquarters.
sentences.zh: 这也是他最喜欢的总部。

sentences.en: The writer Philip Marston, who wrote a brilliant book about this called The Barefoot Emperor, which I recommend to the listeners, he calls Magdala his garrison, his prison,
sentences.zh: 作家菲利普·马斯顿写过一本关于此事的精彩著作《赤脚皇帝》，我向听众推荐这本书，他称马格达拉为他的卫戍区、他的监狱、

sentences.en: his stronghold and home, his asylum, his treasury, and his dungeon.
sentences.zh: 他的坚固据点和家园、他的避难所、他的国库和他的地牢。

sentences.en: This is the Helm's Deep of Abyssinia, this mountain fastness.
sentences.zh: 这就是阿比西尼亚的圣盔谷，这座易守难攻的山区堡垒。

sentences.en: If you go up to the top, you look out, you can see miles and miles around, people approaching.
sentences.zh: 如果你走到山顶眺望，方圆数英里内的情况一览无遗，能看到有人在靠近。

sentences.en: Even a small force can hold this mountain indefinitely.
sentences.zh: 即使是一支小部队也能无限期地坚守这座山。

sentences.en: And in the walled compound on the top of the mountain, Teodros keeps his most valuable treasures.
sentences.zh: 在山顶带墙的庭院里，特沃德罗斯存放着他最宝贵的财宝。

sentences.en: And these are things he's looted from churches across Abyssinia.
sentences.zh: 这些都是他从阿比西尼亚各地的教堂里掠夺来的东西。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，好吧。

sentences.en: So the British aren't the only people who've done some looting in this story.
sentences.zh: 所以在这段故事里，英国人并不是唯一进行掠夺的人。

sentences.en: Oh, good.
sentences.zh: 哦，太好了。

sentences.en: No, no, not at all.
sentences.zh: 不，不，完全不是。

sentences.en: This is the stuff that will end up in Toronto.
sentences.zh: 这些东西最后都会流落到多伦多。

sentences.en: And he also keeps his most important prisoners.
sentences.zh: 他还关押着他最重要的囚犯。

sentences.en: So his rivals, pretenders, the heirs to various regional kingdoms and things.
sentences.zh: 也就是他的对手、竞争者、各地区王国的继承人等等。

sentences.en: Now, he keeps the European prisoners separately.
sentences.zh: 不过，他把欧洲囚犯单独关押。

sentences.en: They're in huts by the cliff edge, just 20 yards from the cliff edge, which some of them find disturbingly close.
sentences.zh: 他们住在悬崖边的简陋小屋里，距离悬崖边缘只有20码，这让其中一些人觉得近得令人不安。

sentences.en: The huts are infested with spiders and rats.
sentences.zh: 小屋里到处都是蜘蛛和老鼠。

sentences.en: The hostages, the missionaries, are fettered at the ankles.
sentences.zh: 人质和传教士的脚踝上都戴着镣铐。

sentences.en: And then these fetters are connected by a chain to a manacle on their hands, which is the chain that is a little bit too short.
sentences.zh: 然后这些镣铐通过一条链子连接到他们手上的手铐上，这条链子稍微有点短。

sentences.en: So they're hunched over the whole time.
sentences.zh: 所以他们整天都驼着背。

sentences.en: And if they want to move around, they're still hunched.
sentences.zh: 如果他们想走动，也依然驼着背。

sentences.en: And they develop severe spinal pain, which is not good.
sentences.zh: 这导致他们患上了严重的脊椎疼痛，情况很不妙。

sentences.en: But from here, Cameron has smuggled messages to the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 但从这里开始，卡梅伦已经将密信偷运到了海岸。

sentences.en: And as Rassam on the coast reads these messages, he's quite disturbed.
sentences.zh: 当身在海岸的拉萨姆读到这些信件时，他感到非常不安。

sentences.en: Because Cameron says, I'm convinced that only military action will persuade the emperor to release us.
sentences.zh: 因为卡梅伦说，我坚信只有采取军事行动才能说服皇帝释放我们。

sentences.en: And he adds a note to Rassam.
sentences.zh: 他在给拉萨姆的便条中补充道。

sentences.en: He says, for God's sake, do not come up here.
sentences.zh: 他说，看在上帝的份上，千万别来这里。

sentences.en: He will cage you as sure as a gun.
sentences.zh: 他绝对会像关笼子一样把你关起来。

sentences.en: And this leaves Rassam in a bit of a quandary.
sentences.zh: 这让拉萨姆陷入了进退两难的境地。

sentences.en: Do I not go?
sentences.zh: 我不去吗？

sentences.en: Am I ever going to get a letter from the emperor himself?
sentences.zh: 我还能收到皇帝本人的信吗？

sentences.en: What should I do?
sentences.zh: 我该怎么办？

sentences.en: And then in August 1865, the emperor's reply finally arrives.
sentences.zh: 到了1865年8月，皇帝的回信终于到了。

sentences.en: And it's a litany of grievances against Stern and Cameron in particular.
sentences.zh: 信中历数了对斯特恩和卡梅伦的各种抱怨。

sentences.en: But also, implicitly, though not quite explicitly stated, there's an invitation to Rassam.
sentences.zh: 但字里行间，虽然没有完全明说，但也包含着对拉萨姆的邀请。

sentences.en: Why don't you come and talk to me?
sentences.zh: 你为什么不来跟我谈谈呢？

sentences.en: So Rassam gets permission from London.
sentences.zh: 于是拉萨姆获得了伦敦的批准。

sentences.en: And then he heads inland with his assistants, Dr. Blanc and Lieutenant Prido.
sentences.zh: 随后，他带着助手布兰克博士和普里多中尉深入内陆。

sentences.en: The countryside by now is barren, desolate, scarred by war and rebellion and famine and plague.
sentences.zh: 此时的乡野满目疮痍、荒凉死寂，战争、叛乱、饥荒和瘟疫蹂躏了这片土地。

sentences.en: The people are kind of skeletal and ghostly.
sentences.zh: 人们瘦骨嶙峋，宛如鬼魅。

sentences.en: It's like something from a zombie apocalypse or something.
sentences.zh: 就像丧尸末日里的场景一样。

sentences.en: And all the time as they advance, it's very kind of Cortez and Montezuma or something.
sentences.zh: 而且在他们前进的整个过程中，感觉非常像科尔特斯和蒙特祖马的故事。

sentences.en: Because all the time, Rassam is getting these rambling letters from Teodros that lurch wildly from a kind of aggressive self-pity to polite, friendly apologies.
sentences.zh: 因为拉萨姆一路上不断收到特沃德罗斯那些语无伦次的信件，内容在富有攻击性的自怜和礼貌友好的道歉之间剧烈摇摆。

sentences.en: So Rassam doesn't really know what to make of this.
sentences.zh: 所以拉萨姆实在搞不懂这到底是怎么回事。

sentences.en: Anyway, the 28th of January, 1866, they reach Teodros' camp.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，1866年1月28日，他们抵达了特沃德罗斯的营地。

sentences.en: And Rassam has been waiting for this moment for a year and a half.
sentences.zh: 拉萨姆为一个半月来的这一刻一直在等待。

sentences.en: I mean, this is a very long-winded enterprise.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个非常冗长的行动。

sentences.en: And he gets into his finery, his best blue diplomatic uniform.
sentences.zh: 他穿上了最讲究的盛装，那是他最好的蓝色外交制服。

sentences.en: And Blanc and Prido are wearing the red uniforms of the British Indian Army.
sentences.zh: 布兰克和普里多则穿着英属印度军队的红色制服。

sentences.en: And once again, you'll be pleased to hear that they find Teodros reclining on a divan, surrounded by musicians and courtiers and bodyguards.
sentences.zh: 你会高兴地听到，他们再次发现特沃德罗斯正斜靠在沙发上，周围环绕着音乐家、朝臣和保镖。

sentences.en: And Rassam hands over Queen Victoria's letter.
sentences.zh: 拉萨姆递交了维多利亚女王的信件。

sentences.en: And Teodros goes into a huge rant about his grievances, not just against the missionaries, but against his own people.
sentences.zh: 特沃德罗斯开始长篇大论地大肆抱怨，不仅抱怨传教士，还抱怨他自己的人民。

sentences.en: He says, my own people are useless as well.
sentences.zh: 他说，我自己的人民也没用。

sentences.en: They're rebellious and violent and uncivilized.
sentences.zh: 他们叛逆、暴力、不开化。

sentences.en: I don't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: I'm beset by opponents.
sentences.zh: 我四面楚歌。

sentences.en: You know, no one understands me, all this.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，没有人理解我，诸如此类。

sentences.en: And Rassam plays all this very skillfully.
sentences.zh: 拉萨姆非常巧妙地应付了这一切。

sentences.en: He doesn't argue with Teodros.
sentences.zh: 他没有跟特沃德罗斯争辩。

sentences.en: He says, oh, I really do sympathize with you.
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，我真的非常同情您。

sentences.en: You have a terrible job.
sentences.zh: 您的工作太难了。

sentences.en: You know, I wouldn't want to be in your shoes.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我可不想处在您的位置上。

sentences.en: You're the father of your people.
sentences.zh: 您是您人民之父。

sentences.en: Maybe the thing to do is to cultivate patience and tolerance.
sentences.zh: 也许现在该做的是培养耐心和包容心。

sentences.en: And maybe you can teach your people to do what is right.
sentences.zh: 也许您可以教导您的人民去做正确的事。

sentences.en: Anyway, you've got a letter here from Queen Victoria.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，您这里有一封来自维多利亚女王的信。

sentences.en: I'm confident that when you read the letter, you will forget the past and try to establish amicable relations with England.
sentences.zh: 我坚信，当您读完这封信时，您会忘掉过去，努力与英国建立友好的关系。

sentences.en: And when Teodros hears this, he is delighted.
sentences.zh: 当特沃德罗斯听到这话时，他高兴极了。

sentences.en: He is absolutely, he's really touched.
sentences.zh: 他简直，他真的被打动了。

sentences.en: In fact, he's so touched that that night he can't sleep.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他感动得当晚难以入眠。

sentences.en: He's so excited.
sentences.zh: 他太兴奋了。

sentences.en: He's finally got the reply that he wanted from Queen Victoria.
sentences.zh: 他终于得到了他想要来自维多利亚女王的回信。

sentences.en: And the next day, at dawn, he dictates a new letter to Victoria.
sentences.zh: 第二天黎明，他口授了一封给维多利亚的新信。

sentences.en: He says, I know God has chosen you from all men to be the champion of religion, to be the friend of the poor and the oppressed.
sentences.zh: 他说，我知道上帝在所有人中选择了你，让你成为宗教的捍卫者，成为穷人和受压迫者的朋友。

sentences.en: He says to her, you must have heard of the ignorance and blindness of us, the Ethiopian people.
sentences.zh: 他对她说，你一定听说过我们埃塞俄比亚人民的无知与盲目。

sentences.en: If you find offensive what I was bold enough to write to you, do not be angry with me.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得我斗胆写给你的话冒犯了你，请不要生我的气。

sentences.en: Advise me.
sentences.zh: 请指导我。

sentences.en: For you, the queen whom God has chosen, have had your eyes opened.
sentences.zh: 因为你，这位被上帝选中的女王，已经大开眼界。

sentences.en: I mean, who knows what Queen Victoria would make of this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，谁知道维多利亚女王会怎么看这封信。

sentences.en: Anyway, he summons Rassam to his tent and he says, you know, I'm feeling so happy now.
sentences.zh: 总之，他把拉萨姆召进帐篷说，你知道吗，我现在感到太高兴了。

sentences.en: I'm going to release all the captives.
sentences.zh: 我要释放所有的俘虏。

sentences.en: I'm going to bring them down from, they're on the top of the mountain.
sentences.zh: 我要把他们从山顶上带下来，他们现在在山顶上。

sentences.en: I'm going to bring them down from the mountain of Magdala and you can take them to the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 我要把他们从马格达拉山上带下来，你可以把他们带到海岸。

sentences.en: You can have free passage.
sentences.zh: 你们可以获得自由通行权。

sentences.en: And Rassam, this is a massive result for Rassam.
sentences.zh: 对于拉萨姆来说，这绝对是一个巨大的成果。

sentences.en: He has totally vindicated the foreign officer's faith.
sentences.zh: 他完全证明了外交官的信任没有错。

sentences.en: And Teodros says, there is one catch.
sentences.zh: 特沃德罗斯说，不过有一个条件。

sentences.en: It's going to take quite a long time to bring the hostages down from Magdala.
sentences.zh: 把人质从马格达拉带下来需要相当长的时间。

sentences.en: And in the meantime, I've got some rebels to deal with.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，我还有一些叛军需要处理。

sentences.en: I'd love it if you would come with me.
sentences.zh: 如果你能跟我一起去，我将不胜感激。

sentences.en: And Rassam says, yeah, fine.
sentences.zh: 拉萨姆说，好吧，没问题。

sentences.en: So they ride out to the head of thousands of men.
sentences.zh: 于是他们骑马来到数千人的队伍最前方。

sentences.en: And during the march, again, it's very Montezuma and Cortez or something.
sentences.zh: 在行军途中，这感觉又非常像蒙特祖马和科尔特斯的故事了。

sentences.en: Teodros often says, I'd like that guy to ride with me, please.
sentences.zh: 特沃德罗斯经常说，请让那个人跟我一起骑马吧。

sentences.en: And he questions him about the British Empire.
sentences.zh: 他向他询问有关大英帝国的事。

sentences.en: How are you getting on in West Africa against the Ashanti?
sentences.zh: 你们在西非对抗阿散蒂的战况怎么样了？

sentences.en: All this kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 诸如此类的问题。

sentences.en: It keeps pestering him with questions about the Crimean War.
sentences.zh: 他不停地用关于克里米亚战争的问题纠缠他。

sentences.en: He cannot get his head around the fact that the British won the Crimean War, but then signed a treaty with Tsar Nicholas I and didn't execute him.
sentences.zh: 他怎么也想不明白，为什么英国赢得了克里米亚战争，却随后与尼古拉一世沙皇签了条约而没有处决他。

sentences.en: That blows his mind anyway.
sentences.zh: 总之这让他大受震撼。

sentences.en: So there's that, right?
sentences.zh: 所以就是这样，对吧？

sentences.en: But then there's two themes that he keeps coming back to.
sentences.zh: 但随后有两个主题是他不断反复提及的。

sentences.en: He's like, mind will wander.
sentences.zh: 他会心不在焉。

sentences.en: And then he'll come back to these themes.
sentences.zh: 然后又会绕回这些主题上来。

sentences.en: One of them is how the missionaries were very rude to him and rude about his genealogy.
sentences.zh: 其中之一就是传教士对他的态度非常粗鲁，并且对他的家世评头论足。

sentences.en: And whenever he talks about it, he starts shaking because he's so cross.
sentences.zh: 每当他谈到这个，他就会气得浑身发抖。

sentences.en: And then the other thing he says, actually, I would like a formal treaty with the British, who are, of course, my brothers.
sentences.zh: 然后另一件事是，其实他想要与英国人建立正式条约，英国人当然是他的兄弟。

sentences.en: And I would love it.
sentences.zh: 他会非常乐意。

sentences.en: He says, I know Queen Victoria is too – I know she's very important and very busy.
sentences.zh: 他说，我知道维多利亚女王太——我知道她位高权重且日理万机。

sentences.en: And she's – you know, I'm small fry to her.
sentences.zh: 她——你知道的，在她眼里我不过是个小人物。

sentences.en: But I also know she has a lot of governors in India, and I would love it if she would appoint one of her governors in India
sentences.zh: 但我也知道她在印度有很多总督，如果她能委任她在印度的某位总督

sentences.en: to be my sort of contact, my point man, just for me, that I could talk to.
sentences.zh: 来做我的某种联系人、我的对接口，专属于我，让我可以跟他对话，我将不胜感激。

sentences.en: And Rassam is very diplomatic, you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，拉萨姆非常外交辞令。

sentences.en: He says to him, well, when I get back to London with the hostages, I will talk to Her Majesty's government, and I'm sure they'll look kindly on Your Majesty's proposal.
sentences.zh: 他对他说，嗯，当我带着人质回到伦敦后，我会与女王陛下的政府谈谈，我相信他们会以善意看待陛下您的提议。

sentences.en: Teodros says, oh, great, thank you.
sentences.zh: 特沃德罗斯说，哦，太好了，谢谢你。

sentences.en: They reach a place called Lake Tana.
sentences.zh: 他们到达了一个叫塔纳湖的地方。

sentences.en: Here they part.
sentences.zh: 在这里他们分道扬镳。

sentences.en: Teodros is going off to attack some rebels, and Rassam's going to wait for the hostages.
sentences.zh: 特沃德罗斯去攻打一些叛军，而拉萨姆则留在原地等待人质。

sentences.en: And Rassam waits by the lakeside for the hostages.
sentences.zh: 拉萨姆在湖边等待人质的到来。

sentences.en: And every few days, Teodros sends him gifts on letters.
sentences.zh: 每隔几天，特沃德罗斯就会派人送来礼物和信件。

sentences.en: So Teodros sends him some bizarre gifts.
sentences.zh: 于是特沃德罗斯送给他一些奇奇怪怪的礼物。

sentences.en: He sends him muskets, pistols, manuscripts that he's looted.
sentences.zh: 他送给他滑膛枪、手枪、他掠夺来的手稿。

sentences.en: He sends Rassam an antelope, two lion cubs, two monkeys, and a baboon.
sentences.zh: 他送给拉萨姆一只羚羊、两只狮子幼崽、两只猴子和一只狒狒。

sentences.en: Oh, really?
sentences.zh: 哦，真的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He could start his own zoo with this stuff.
sentences.zh: 他可以用这些东西开个自己的动物园了。

sentences.en: His own menagerie.
sentences.zh: 他自己的私人动物园。

sentences.en: What does Rassam do with them?
sentences.zh: 拉萨姆拿它们怎么办？

sentences.en: Didn't they just hang out?
sentences.zh: 它们难道就只是瞎晃悠吗？

sentences.en: Just hang out, the baboon and the antelope and the lion cubs?
sentences.zh: 狒狒、羚羊和狮子幼崽就只是待在一起？

sentences.en: I mean, they're well known for getting on with one another.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它们可是出了名能和睦相处的。

sentences.en: What could go wrong?
sentences.zh: 能出什么岔子呢？

sentences.en: And also a load of irreplaceable ancient manuscripts.
sentences.zh: 还有一大堆无可替代的古代手稿。

sentences.en: If ever I'm given an ancient manuscript, I make sure to put it with a baboon, because I think what could go wrong?
sentences.zh: 如果我拿到一本古代手稿，我一定会把它和狒狒放在一起，因为我想能出什么岔子呢？

sentences.en: Anyway.
sentences.zh: 总之。

sentences.en: On the 12th of March, 1866, the hostages finally turn up.
sentences.zh: 1866年3月12日，人质们终于出现了。

sentences.en: They've been marched down through the mountains.
sentences.zh: 他们是被一路押送穿过群山走下来的。

sentences.en: They're absolutely knackered.
sentences.zh: 他们筋疲力尽。

sentences.en: They're ill.
sentences.zh: 他们病了。

sentences.en: There's 23 of them.
sentences.zh: 这里有23个人。

sentences.en: Seemingly, they're not still, they haven't got this kind of, they're fettered to the ankles with their curved spine.
sentences.zh: 看起来，他们没法静止，他们没法这样，他们弯曲的脊椎让脚踝被脚镣锁住。

sentences.en: They have been fettered all the way.
sentences.zh: 他们一路上都被锁着。

sentences.en: How do they walk?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么走路的？

sentences.en: It's just general trudging, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想，就是普通地艰难跋涉。

sentences.en: Sort of hunched over trudging.
sentences.zh: 有点驼着背艰难跋涉。

sentences.en: Oh, that's awful.
sentences.zh: 哦，太惨了。

sentences.en: They're alive.
sentences.zh: 他们还活着。

sentences.en: I mean, that's the plus.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这是值得庆幸的。

sentences.en: Their chains, because their chains are not removed until they get to the lake.
sentences.zh: 他们的铁链，因为他们的铁链直到到了湖边才被解开。

sentences.en: And at that point, Rassam thinks, finally, you know, this is, we've sorted this out.
sentences.zh: 而到了那个时候，拉萨姆认为，终于，你知道的，这，我们把这事解决了。

sentences.en: Teodros, who at this stage appears absolutely lovesick.
sentences.zh: 特奥德罗斯，此时看起来完全是一副害了相思病的模样。

sentences.en: He's so infatuated with Rassam.
sentences.zh: 他太迷恋拉萨姆了。

sentences.en: He's still sending him presents.
sentences.zh: 他还在送他礼物。

sentences.en: He sends him some cows.
sentences.zh: 他送了他一些牛。

sentences.en: He sends him some money.
sentences.zh: 他送了他一些钱。

sentences.en: He says, please don't go off just yet.
sentences.zh: 他说，请先别急着走。

sentences.en: I'm having a special medal made for you.
sentences.zh: 我正在为你定制一枚特殊的勋章。

sentences.en: It's called the Cross and Solomon's Seal.
sentences.zh: 它叫十字架与所罗门之印。

sentences.en: I've also commissioned special shields for you and Dr. Blanc and Lieutenant Prido, and a special golden saddle for you to mark our friendship.
sentences.zh: 我还为你、布兰克医生和普里多中尉订制了特殊的盾牌，以及一副特制的金鞍具，来纪念我们的友谊。

sentences.en: In all, Teodros sent Rassam 23 letters.
sentences.zh: 总共算下来，特奥德罗斯给拉萨姆寄了23封信。

sentences.en: And Rassam, at this point, starts to feel a little, as you might, a little disturbed.
sentences.zh: 而拉萨姆此时开始觉得有点，你懂的，有点心神不宁。

sentences.en: This friendship has got an unhealthy dimension to it.
sentences.zh: 这份友谊已经有了一种不健康的维度。

sentences.en: Because, basically, it appears that Teodros has got a massive crush on him.
sentences.zh: 因为基本上，看起来特奥德罗斯对他是迷恋得深沉。

sentences.en: A pash.
sentences.zh: 一头热。

sentences.en: And, yeah, a pash.
sentences.zh: 没错，就是一头热。

sentences.en: And Rassam becomes genuinely concerned.
sentences.zh: 而拉萨姆开始真正感到担忧。

sentences.en: Is he ever going to, you know, is he going to let me go?
sentences.zh: 他到底会不会，你知道的，他会不会放我走？

sentences.en: Because he seems absolutely besotted with me.
sentences.zh: 因为他看起来对我迷恋得无可救药。

sentences.en: And at last, Teodros arrives back at the lake.
sentences.zh: 最后，特奥德罗斯回到了湖边。

sentences.en: And his first words to Rassam, perhaps a little bit ominous, because he takes him by the hand and says to him, I feel as happy as if I were visiting the queen.
sentences.zh: 他对拉萨姆说的第一句话，也许有点不祥的预兆，因为他拉着拉萨姆的手对他说，我感到高兴极了，就像去拜访女王一样。

sentences.en: So I says, oh, brilliant.
sentences.zh: 所以我说，哦，太棒了。

sentences.en: And then Teodros says, I want to introduce you to my eldest son.
sentences.zh: 然后特奥德罗斯说，我想把你介绍给我的长子。

sentences.en: Can you shake hands, please?
sentences.zh: 请握个手好吗？

sentences.en: And he says, I would really love it if Queen Victoria would adopt my sons as her wards, so that when I die, they may be looked after by the English and not allowed to govern badly.
sentences.zh: 他说，如果维多利亚女王能把我的儿子们收为受监护人，我将不胜感激，这样当我死后，他们就能受到英国人的照顾，而不会被胡乱统治。

sentences.en: And Rassam says, yeah, we can probably look into that.
sentences.zh: 拉萨姆说，行吧，我们可能会考虑一下。

sentences.en: Fine.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Now, Teodros, at this point, is very erratic.
sentences.zh: 现在，特奥德罗斯此时的状态非常反复无常。

sentences.en: I think there's probably a lot of drinking.
sentences.zh: 我想他大概喝了不少酒。

sentences.en: He's still lurching between these attacks on the missionaries.
sentences.zh: 他仍然在这类对传教士的攻击之间摇摆不定。

sentences.en: And then he'll burst into tears and say how much he loves Britain and how he loves Rassam and Queen Victoria.
sentences.zh: 然后他会突然放声大哭，说他多么热爱英国，多么爱拉萨姆和维多利亚女王。

sentences.en: At one point, he gets very maudlin.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他变得非常多愁善感。

sentences.en: He says to Rassam, I know that when you go, you will forget me.
sentences.zh: 他对拉萨姆说，我知道你走的时候，会忘记我。

sentences.en: You will forget your friend.
sentences.zh: 你会忘记你的朋友。

sentences.en: I mean, to be fair to Rassam, Rassam is not going to forget this, is he?
sentences.zh: 我是说，平心而论，拉萨姆是不会忘记这一幕的，对吧？

sentences.en: No, this bloke has given you a baboon and burst into tears in front of you.
sentences.zh: 没错，这家伙送了你一只狒狒，还在你面前痛哭流涕。

sentences.en: You're never going to forget it.
sentences.zh: 你永远都不会忘掉的。

sentences.en: You don't forget a man who gives you a baboon.
sentences.zh: 你不会忘记一个送你狒狒的人。

sentences.en: I remember all the people who've given me baboons.
sentences.zh: 我记得所有送过我狒狒的人。

sentences.en: So Rassam is a little bit anxious, but on the 13th of April, orders come that the camp is going to be packed up.
sentences.zh: 所以拉萨姆有点焦虑，但在4月13日，命令下达了，营地将要收拾行装。

sentences.en: And he thinks, alas, we are going to go home.
sentences.zh: 他想，唉，我们要回家了。

sentences.en: The missionaries wait on the eastern side of the lake.
sentences.zh: 传教士们在湖的东侧等待。

sentences.en: Rassam and Dr. Blanc and Lieutenant Prido cross the lake to go and say goodbye to Teodros.
sentences.zh: 拉萨姆、布兰克医生和普里多中尉横渡湖泊去向特奥德罗斯告别。

sentences.en: It's only polite to say goodbye to him.
sentences.zh: 去跟他告别只是出于礼貌。

sentences.en: And they get to his camp, and they find it oddly silent.
sentences.zh: 他们到了他的营地，发现这里出奇地安静。

sentences.en: And they're shown by the guards into Teodros' pavilion.
sentences.zh: 卫兵带他们走进了特奥德罗斯的帐篷。

sentences.en: And in his pavilion are all Teodros' courtiers and his bodyguards, as usual, who are just staring at them.
sentences.zh: 在他的帐篷里，像往常一样全都是特奥德罗斯的朝臣和保镖，他们只是死死盯着他们。

sentences.en: But the throne is at the end of the pavilion, and there's no Teodros on the throne, which they find weird.
sentences.zh: 但宝座在帐篷尽头，宝座上却没有特奥德罗斯，他们觉得这很诡异。

sentences.en: And at that moment, they notice there's no one on the throne.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他们注意到宝座上没有人。

sentences.en: And Rassam feels a hand on his arm, and then he feels a hand on his other arm.
sentences.zh: 拉萨姆感到一只手搭在胳膊上，接着又感到另一只胳膊上搭了一只手。

sentences.en: And it's the guards.
sentences.zh: 是卫兵。

sentences.en: And he realizes they're under arreSt.
sentences.zh: 他意识到他们被捕了。

sentences.en: No!
sentences.zh: 不会吧！

sentences.en: Yes!
sentences.zh: 没错！

sentences.en: That's the twist!
sentences.zh: 这就是反转！

sentences.en: Oh my god!
sentences.zh: 我的天哪！

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I believed in Teodros' love for him.
sentences.zh: 我曾相信特奥德罗斯对他是真爱。

sentences.en: I think Teodros does love Rassam.
sentences.zh: 我想特奥德罗斯确实爱拉萨姆。

sentences.en: So the missionaries, by the way, are being rounded up at this point again.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，传教士们此时又被集中起来了。

sentences.en: Again.
sentences.zh: 又来了。

sentences.en: Oh, and put back in their shackles.
sentences.zh: 哦，又给戴回了脚镣。

sentences.en: And put back in their shackles.
sentences.zh: 又给戴回了脚镣。

sentences.en: Now, let's come to this.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们来谈谈这个。

sentences.en: What's going on?
sentences.zh: 到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Like, what is Teodros thinking?
sentences.zh: 话说，特奥德罗斯在想什么？

sentences.en: There are various possibilities.
sentences.zh: 有几种可能。

sentences.en: Number one is that he was lying all the time.
sentences.zh: 第一种是他从头到尾都在撒谎。

sentences.en: He was playing games with Rassam.
sentences.zh: 他在耍拉萨姆玩。

sentences.en: Number two is that he wasn't, but at the last minute, he was overcome by his hatred of the missionaries.
sentences.zh: 第二种是他没有撒谎，但在最后一分钟，他对传教士的恨意占了上风。

sentences.en: And number three is he did love Rassam, after all.
sentences.zh: 第三种是他终究还是爱拉萨姆的。

sentences.en: Yeah, he couldn't bear to let him go.
sentences.zh: 对，他舍不得放他走。

sentences.en: Couldn't bear to let him go.
sentences.zh: 舍不得放他走。

sentences.en: I think that seems the likelieSt.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这似乎最有可能。

sentences.en: Well, in his biography of Teodros and his sort of discussion of this, Philip Marsden says, you know, Rassam couldn't really understand it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，菲利普·马森在他关于特奥德罗斯的传记以及对这事的讨论中说，你知道的，拉萨姆其实无法理解这一点。

sentences.en: And like Rassam, we are lost in a labyrinth of contradictory messages made more confusing by the emperor's growing paranoia.
sentences.zh: 和拉萨姆一样，我们在充满矛盾信息的迷宫中迷失了方向，而皇帝日益严重的偏执让这一切更加令人费解。

sentences.en: However, Marsden says, probably Teodros is infatuated with Rassam.
sentences.zh: 然而，马森说，特奥德罗斯很可能迷恋上了拉萨姆。

sentences.en: And he sees Rassam as his best chance of getting friendship with Britain and getting British technology and as a sort of link with the outside world.
sentences.zh: 他将拉萨姆视为与英国建立友谊、获取英国技术的最佳机会，并将其视为与外界联系的某种纽带。

sentences.en: And he simply cannot bear to let him go.
sentences.zh: 他简直舍不得放他走。

sentences.en: He wants to keep him.
sentences.zh: 他想把他留在身边。

sentences.en: In a way, quite touching.
sentences.zh: 从某种程度上说，挺感人的。

sentences.en: Yeah, in a weird way.
sentences.zh: 对，用一种诡异的方式。

sentences.en: It is actually quite touching.
sentences.zh: 其实确实挺感人的。

sentences.en: I mean, not for Rassam, obviously, but.
sentences.zh: 我是说，对拉萨姆来说当然不是，不过。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Anyway, so three days later, the whole load of them are brought into his tent for yet another show trial.
sentences.zh: 总之，三天后，他们全部被带进他的帐篷，进行又一场摆样子的审判。

sentences.en: So it's now quite correct.
sentences.zh: 所以现在人数刚刚好。

sentences.en: There's about 30 of them.
sentences.zh: 大约有30个人。

sentences.en: So Rassam and Prido and Blanc and whatnot.
sentences.zh: 也就是拉萨姆、普里多、布兰克之流。

sentences.en: Yeah, he's collecting quite a lot, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 是啊，他收集的人数可真不少，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, Teodros is collecting hostages.
sentences.zh: 对，特奥德罗斯在收集人质。

sentences.en: The full set.
sentences.zh: 集齐一套了。

sentences.en: And Teodros says, this is all your fault, Rassam.
sentences.zh: 特奥德罗斯说，这全都是你的错，拉萨姆。

sentences.en: You should have brought the missionaries to see me before you left.
sentences.zh: 你离开前本该把传教士带来见我的。

sentences.en: It was very rude of you not to bring them when you came to say goodbye.
sentences.zh: 你来道别时没把他们带来，这太粗鲁了。

sentences.en: Is this your friendship, Mr. Rassam, that you wish to leave me and take away those who have abused me?
sentences.zh: 拉萨姆先生，这就是你的友谊吗，你想离开我，还要带走那些虐待过我的人？

sentences.en: And the next day, Teodros dictates a new letter to Queen Victoria.
sentences.zh: 第二天，特奥德罗斯口述了一封给维多利亚女王的新信件。

sentences.en: He says, I'm actually keeping your envoy.
sentences.zh: 他说，我实际上扣留了你的特使。

sentences.en: And all these people as my guests.
sentences.zh: 还有所有人作为我的贵宾。

sentences.en: And in the meantime, I would like you to send me some skillful artists to make me some guns.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，我希望你派一些手艺高超的工匠来为我制造枪炮。

sentences.en: Oh, they're always the guns.
sentences.zh: 哦，总是离不开枪炮。

sentences.en: I want blacksmiths, I want gunsmiths, I want artillery specialists.
sentences.zh: 我要铁匠，我要枪匠，我要火炮专家。

sentences.en: And when I'm satisfied, I shall, through the power of God, give them a splendid payment and with great honour, send them back.
sentences.zh: 当我对他们满意时，靠着上帝的力量，我将给予他们丰厚的报酬，并以崇高的荣誉将他们送回。

sentences.en: Now, he's got to get this letter to Queen Victoria.
sentences.zh: 现在，他得把这封信送到维多利亚女王手里。

sentences.en: And of course, he doesn't want to let Rassam go.
sentences.zh: 当然，他又不想让拉萨姆走。

sentences.en: So he chooses one of the missionaries to do it.
sentences.zh: 所以他挑选了其中一名传教士去办这件事。

sentences.en: And this is a German man with the terrible name of Martin Fladd.
sentences.zh: 这是一个德国人，名字挺糟糕，叫马丁·弗拉德。

sentences.en: And he's a reverend, the Reverend Martin Fladd.
sentences.zh: 他是一位牧师，马丁·弗拉德牧师。

sentences.en: The Reverend Martin Fladd had also been sent by the London Society for the Promotion of Christianity Among the Jews.
sentences.zh: 马丁·弗拉德牧师也是被“伦敦宣扬犹太人基督教徒协会”派来的。

sentences.en: And Fladd had come to Abyssinia with his wife and three children.
sentences.zh: 弗拉德带着妻子和三个孩子来到了阿比西尼亚。

sentences.en: Fladd doesn't want to leave his family behind.
sentences.zh: 弗拉德不想把家人抛在身后。

sentences.en: He hates Teodros.
sentences.zh: 他恨特奥德罗斯。

sentences.en: He calls him a savage, a cruel, inhuman and sly despot.
sentences.zh: 他称他为野蛮人、残酷、不人道且狡猾的暴君。

sentences.en: But he feels he doesn't have any choice.
sentences.zh: 但他觉得自己别无选择。

sentences.en: So Fladd sets off with this letter.
sentences.zh: 于是弗拉德带着这封信出发了。

sentences.en: He makes very good progress.
sentences.zh: 他的进展非常顺利。

sentences.en: He gets to London in July 1866.
sentences.zh: 他在1866年7月到达伦敦。

sentences.en: And he goes to the Foreign Office.
sentences.zh: 他去了外交部。

sentences.en: And he gives them the letter.
sentences.zh: 他把信交给了他们。

sentences.en: And he tells them Teodros' demands.
sentences.zh: 并把特奥德罗斯的要求告诉了他们。

sentences.en: And he says to them, this bloke Teodros is mad.
sentences.zh: 他对他们说，这个叫特奥德罗斯的家伙疯了。

sentences.en: Don't send troops.
sentences.zh: 千万别派军队。

sentences.en: If British soldiers set foot on Abyssinian soil, he will in a most cruel and barbarous manner slaughter all our people.
sentences.zh: 如果英国士兵踏上阿比西尼亚的土地，他会以最残酷、最野蛮的方式屠杀我们所有人。

sentences.en: Just give him what he wants.
sentences.zh: 直接给他想要的东西吧。

sentences.en: You know, we've done hostage crises before.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们以前处理过人质危机。

sentences.en: We did the Iran hostage crisis.
sentences.zh: 我们处理过伊朗人质危机。

sentences.en: This is a problem, you know, that is a perennial issue that governments have to face.
sentences.zh: 这是一个问题，你知道的，是各国政府不得不面对的一个老生常谈的问题。

sentences.en: Do you intervene militarily?
sentences.zh: 你要进行军事干预吗？

sentences.en: Or does that mean you risk the deaths of all the hostages?
sentences.zh: 还是说这意味着你要冒着所有名人质死亡的风险？

sentences.en: Anyway, the Foreign Office at this point think, well, we don't want to intervene in Abyssinia.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，外交部此时认为，好吧，我们不想干涉阿比西尼亚。

sentences.en: They arrange for loads of stuff, a mad collection of stuff, a steam engine, a gunpowder mill, smelting equipment, a hunting rifle, a telescope.
sentences.zh: 他们安排了大量的物资，一堆疯狂的杂物，一台蒸汽机、一座火药厂、冶炼设备、一把猎枪、一台望远镜。

sentences.en: This is all going to be sent to the Red Sea.
sentences.zh: 这些都要被运往红海。

sentences.en: And they're going to send a team of workmen to handle it.
sentences.zh: 他们还要派出一支工匠团队来处理这些。

sentences.en: However, there is a catch.
sentences.zh: 然而，这里有个陷阱。

sentences.en: They say to Vlad, you go ahead with a new letter from Queen Victoria.
sentences.zh: 他们对弗拉德说，你带着维多利亚女王的新信件继续前进。

sentences.en: And when Teodros releases the hostages, he can have his smelting equipment.
sentences.zh: 等特奥德罗斯释放人质后，他就能拿到他的冶炼设备了。

sentences.en: Not before.
sentences.zh: 在此之前不行。

sentences.en: So, Vlad goes back to Abyssinia.
sentences.zh: 所以，弗拉德回到了阿比西尼亚。

sentences.en: He gets to the Red Sea coaSt.
sentences.zh: 他到达了红海海岸。

sentences.en: There are messages from the hostages waiting for him, including his wife and children.
sentences.zh: 那里有等人质留给他的消息，包括他的妻子和孩子。

sentences.en: They're all alive, but they're having a very, very weird time as guests of the emperor.
sentences.zh: 他们都还活着，但作为皇帝的座上宾，他们过着非常、非常诡异的生活。

sentences.en: So, on the one hand, Teodros has presented Rasam with his medal and his golden saddle.
sentences.zh: 所以，一方面，特沃德罗斯向拉萨姆赠送了他的勋章和金马鞍。

sentences.en: He threw a party for Queen Victoria's birthday, where he demonstrated some of his guns.
sentences.zh: 他为维多利亚女王的生日举办了一场派对，并在会上展示了他的一些枪械。

sentences.en: He's taken Rasam's shooting.
sentences.zh: 他拿走了拉萨姆的枪。

sentences.en: And they have had some excellent chats about Alexander the Great.
sentences.zh: 他们就亚历山大大帝进行了一些非常精彩的交谈。

sentences.en: Because Teodros is, did you know this, Teodros is not just descended from Solomon.
sentences.zh: 因为特沃德罗斯——你知道吗，特沃德罗斯不仅仅是所罗门的后代。

sentences.en: He's actually also descended from Alexander.
sentences.zh: 实际上，他也是亚历山大的后代。

sentences.en: I did not know that.
sentences.zh: 我以前不知道这一点。

sentences.en: Goodness.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: So, more complexity for his genealogists to wrestle with.
sentences.zh: 所以，这给他的族谱学家们增添了更多的复杂性。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: There's a lot going on there.
sentences.zh: 那里发生了很多事情。

sentences.en: On the other hand, occasionally, Teodros will go mad.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，特沃德罗斯偶尔会发疯。

sentences.en: He will force them to watch him whipping his courtiers to death.
sentences.zh: 他会强迫他们看着他用鞭子将朝臣活活抽死。

sentences.en: And he will go into these mad rants and things.
sentences.zh: 他会陷入这种疯狂的咆哮和诸如此类的情绪中。

sentences.en: And do we think these stories are true?
sentences.zh: 我们觉得这些故事是真的吗？

sentences.en: Because mad despots having rants and whipping people to death is a kind of staple of…
sentences.zh: 因为疯狂的暴君大发雷霆、把人活活抽死，某种程度上可以说是……

sentences.en: I think they're totally true.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它们完全是真的。

sentences.en: There's enough missionary…
sentences.zh: 有足够的传教士……

sentences.en: Some of these missionaries are very pious and slightly dull people.
sentences.zh: 其中一些传教士非常虔诚，而且有点无趣。

sentences.en: They're not making stuff up.
sentences.zh: 他们可没有凭空捏造。

sentences.en: The climax of this is he locks them all in a sort of black hole of Calcutta-style cellar.
sentences.zh: 这一切的高潮是，他把他们全都锁进了一种加尔各答黑洞式的地牢里。

sentences.en: And then he comes in.
sentences.zh: 然后他走了进来。

sentences.en: They're all in the cellar, like hunched over in their chains.
sentences.zh: 他们全都在地牢里，戴着镣铐弓着身子。

sentences.en: He comes in with a bottle of Arak, kind of Raki-type thing.
sentences.zh: 他拿着一瓶阿拉克酒走进来，有点像拉克酒那种东西。

sentences.en: And sits down and just sits there drinking and talking to them.
sentences.zh: 然后坐下来，就坐在那里一边喝酒一边跟他们聊天。

sentences.en: And they find that very stressful.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得这非常让人压力山大。

sentences.en: Can I ask, what language are they talking in?
sentences.zh: 请问，他们在用什么语言交谈？

sentences.en: He speaks Amharic.
sentences.zh: 他说阿姆哈拉语。

sentences.en: And do they, by now, speak it?
sentences.zh: 到了这个时候，他们也会说吗？

sentences.en: I guess they do.
sentences.zh: 我想他们会的。

sentences.en: They must speak some.
sentences.zh: 他们总得会说一点吧。

sentences.en: Maybe there's interpreters there that we don't know about.
sentences.zh: 也许那里有我们不知道的翻译。

sentences.en: But I think they must understand.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得他们一定能听懂。

sentences.en: Maybe they can only pick up one in every four words.
sentences.zh: 也许他们只能听懂四个词里的一个。

sentences.en: But I think they get the giSt.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得他们大概能明白意思。

sentences.en: Alexander Solomon.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大·所罗门。

sentences.en: He's drinking and chatting.
sentences.zh: 他一边喝酒一边聊天。

sentences.en: And then at the very end, he's finished the bottle.
sentences.zh: 然后到了最后，他喝完了整瓶酒。

sentences.en: And he says to them very quietly and slightly sadly,
sentences.zh: 他非常轻声且略带伤感地对他们说，

sentences.en: My father was mad.
sentences.zh: 我的父亲是个疯子。

sentences.en: And though people often say that I am mad, I never would believe it.
sentences.zh: 尽管人们经常说我是个疯子，但我绝不相信。

sentences.en: But now I know it's true.
sentences.zh: 但现在我知道这是真的了。

sentences.en: And then Rassam says to him,
sentences.zh: 然后拉萨姆对他说，

sentences.en: Don't say such a thing.
sentences.zh: 别说这样的话。

sentences.en: And Teodros gets up and he goes to the doorway.
sentences.zh: 特沃德罗斯站起身，走向门口。

sentences.en: And he looks back and he says in a hoarse whisper,
sentences.zh: 他回过头，用嘶哑的低语说道，

sentences.en: I am mad.
sentences.zh: 我是个疯子。

sentences.en: Goodbye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: And then off he goes.
sentences.zh: 然后他就离开了。

sentences.en: I think that's a bit disconcerting, frankly.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我觉得这有点让人不安。

sentences.en: So that's the last they see of him for almost two years.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是他们近两年来最后一次见到他。

sentences.en: Two years?
sentences.zh: 两年？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: They left him in that cellar for two years?
sentences.zh: 他们把他关在那地牢里两年？

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不。

sentences.en: They're brought out again.
sentences.zh: 他们又被带出来了。

sentences.en: They're brought out.
sentences.zh: 他们被带出来了。

sentences.en: In fact, what happens to them is they're taken back up to Magdala, to the mountain citadel, 10,000 feet above sea level.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们的遭遇是，他们被带回了海滨山城马格达拉，那里海拔一万英尺。

sentences.en: And they're chained up and they're put in their huts.
sentences.zh: 他们被戴上镣铐关在各自的茅屋里。

sentences.en: Teodros goes off to fight some rebels.
sentences.zh: 特沃德罗斯去攻打叛军了。

sentences.en: He's now proceeding with extreme cruelty, taking thousands of prisoners, massacring villages, stealing people's sacred books, all this.
sentences.zh: 他现在行事极其残忍，抓捕了数千名俘虏，屠杀村庄，抢夺人们的圣书，诸如此类。

sentences.en: So this is the picture that greets this guy, by Flad, when he returns to the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是弗拉德回到海岸时迎面看到的景象。

sentences.en: And the letters that he's got from the missionaries are all very bleak.
sentences.zh: 他从传教士那里收到的信件全都是一片惨淡。

sentences.en: So the Swiss missionary, Theophanus Valdemeyer, says, If you brought all this stuff, you might as well throw it in the sea, because Teodros would rather cut all the Europeans
sentences.zh: 因此，瑞士传教士特奥法努斯·瓦尔德迈尔说，如果你把这些东西都带来了，还不如直接扔进海里，因为特沃德罗斯宁愿把所有欧洲人

sentences.en: into a thousand pieces than hand them over.
sentences.zh: 碎尸万段，也不会把他们交出去。

sentences.en: And Flad's wife, Pauline, has written him a very depressing letter.
sentences.zh: 弗拉德的妻子波琳给他写了一封非常令人沮丧的信。

sentences.en: I entreat you, don't trust, don't trust, don't truSt.
sentences.zh: 我恳求你，不要相信，不要相信，千万不要相信。

sentences.en: If the workmen come, not a single soul will be able to leave the country.
sentences.zh: 如果工匠们来了，没有一个人能离开这个国家。

sentences.en: Flad, however, is determined to come anyway.
sentences.zh: 然而，弗拉德还是决定无论如何都要来。

sentences.en: So he rides through this sort of war-ravaged landscape, and he finds Teodros in his camp.
sentences.zh: 于是他骑马穿过这片饱受战争蹂躏的土地，在军营里找到了特沃德罗斯。

sentences.en: And rather disconcertingly,
sentences.zh: 更令人不安的是，

sentences.en: Teodros is surrounded by the rotting bodies of starved horses.
sentences.zh: 特沃德罗斯周围环绕着饿死的马匹腐烂的尸体。

sentences.en: It's actually a bit like George Washington's camp at Valley Forge.
sentences.zh: 这实际上有点像乔治·华盛顿在福吉谷的营地。

sentences.en: Not clearing them up.
sentences.zh: 根本不清理它们。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And Flad presents Teodros with a telescope, a little taster of the gifts he will have when he releases the hostages.
sentences.zh: 弗拉德向特沃德罗斯赠送了一台望远镜，这是他释放人质时将获得的礼物的见面礼。

sentences.en: Teodros throws the telescope aside, and he says, the man who sends me this telescope only wants to annoy me.
sentences.zh: 特沃德罗斯把望远镜往旁边一扔，说道，送我这台望远镜的人只是想惹恼我。

sentences.en: Teodros says, what's your queen got to say?
sentences.zh: 特沃德罗斯说，你们女王有什么要说的？

sentences.en: And Flad says, well, basically, if you don't release the hostages, you have no right to expect any further friendship.
sentences.zh: 弗拉德说，嗯，基本上就是，如果你不释放人质，你就没有资格期望得到任何进一步的友谊。

sentences.en: Teodros is shocked by this.
sentences.zh: 特沃德罗斯对此感到震惊。

sentences.en: He's totally silent.
sentences.zh: 他一言不发。

sentences.en: And then he says quietly,
sentences.zh: 然后他轻声说道，

sentences.en: very well, I ask from them a sign of friendship, but it is refused to me.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我向他们索要友谊的象征，但被拒绝了。

sentences.en: So be it.
sentences.zh: 那就这样吧。

sentences.en: Flad is led away to join the hostages.
sentences.zh: 弗拉德被带走去加入人质的行列。

sentences.en: So this is his reunion.
sentences.zh: 这就是他的重聚。

sentences.en: I mean, he basically voluntarily goes back into captivity to see his wife and children.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他基本上是自愿回到囚禁之中去见他的妻子和孩子。

sentences.en: And that, it seems, is that.
sentences.zh: 事情似乎就是这样了。

sentences.en: Teodros is not going to let them go.
sentences.zh: 特沃德罗斯是不打算放他们走了。

sentences.en: The British are not going to give him all his equipment.
sentences.zh: 英国人也不会把所有的装备都给他。

sentences.en: A total stalemate.
sentences.zh: 彻底陷入僵局。

sentences.en: And the stalemate remains like that for six months.
sentences.zh: 这种僵局就这样持续了六个月。

sentences.en: Teodros is off fighting rebels.
sentences.zh: 特沃德罗斯去打叛军了。

sentences.en: The hostages are all huddled together at Magdala and they're hearing ever more sort of blood curdling rumours about his growing madness and cruelty.
sentences.zh: 人质们都挤在马格达拉，他们听到了越来越多关于他日益疯狂和残忍的骇人听闻的传言。

sentences.en: They are convinced that eventually he will come back to Magdala and he'll just say, kill the lot of them.
sentences.zh: 他们确信他最终会回到马格达拉，然后就会下令：把他们全杀了。

sentences.en: In March,
sentences.zh: 在三月，

sentences.en: Dr. Blanc writes a note that is smuggled to the coast and then to the foreign office.
sentences.zh: 布兰克医生写了一张便条，被走私到海岸，然后送到了外交部。

sentences.en: And he says,
sentences.zh: 他在信中说，

sentences.en: I'm going to tell you the whole story of Teodros and his rise, his crimes, our plight, his madness.
sentences.zh: 我要把特沃德罗斯的全部故事讲给你们听，他的发迹、他的罪行、我们的困境、他的疯狂。

sentences.en: And Blanc says, the time for talking to this guy is over.
sentences.zh: 布兰克说，跟这家伙谈话的时代已经结束了。

sentences.en: And I quote, only one thing remains, force.
sentences.zh: 我原话奉告，只剩下一条路：武力。

sentences.en: But of course,
sentences.zh: 但当然，

sentences.en: Dr. Blanc doesn't know whether his note is even going to get there or whether, whether anybody is listening or anything like this.
sentences.zh: 布兰克医生并不知道他的便条是否能送达，也不知道是否有人在听，或者诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: And then one day in the early summer of 1867,
sentences.zh: 然后，在1867年初夏的一天，

sentences.en: a messenger stumbles into Teodros' camp and he has a letter come from the Red Sea coaSt.
sentences.zh: 一个信使跌跌撞撞地闯入特沃德罗斯的军营，他带来了一封来自红海海岸的信。

sentences.en: And the letter is an ultimatum from London.
sentences.zh: 这封信是来自伦敦的最后通牒。

sentences.en: The British government have lost patience.
sentences.zh: 英国政府已经失去了耐心。

sentences.en: They're giving him three months to release the hostages.
sentences.zh: 他们给了他三个月的时间释放人质。

sentences.en: And after that, they will cut off all talks.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，他们将切断所有对话。

sentences.en: And the implication is that they will begin military action.
sentences.zh: 其潜台词是他们将展开军事行动。

sentences.en: Is Teodros going to accept?
sentences.zh: 特沃德罗斯会接受吗？

sentences.en: Spoiler, he will not.
sentences.zh: 剧透一下，他不会。

sentences.en: And so it is that on the 19th of August,
sentences.zh: 就这样，在8月19日，

sentences.en: Lord Derby's cabinet meet in London to decide their next move.
sentences.zh: 德比勋爵的内阁在伦敦开会，决定他们的下一步行动。

sentences.en: And there's never any doubt really about what that will be.
sentences.zh: 对于那会是什么，其实从来没有任何疑问。

sentences.en: Diplomacy has failed.
sentences.zh: 外交已经失败。

sentences.en: It is time for war.
sentences.zh: 是时候开战了。

sentences.en: It's war.
sentences.zh: 要开战了。

sentences.en: What a cliffhanger.
sentences.zh: 真是个悬念迭起的发展。

sentences.en: Unbelievable drama.
sentences.zh: 难以置信的戏剧性。

sentences.en: And members of the Rest of the History Club can find out what happens next.
sentences.zh: “历史其余部分”俱乐部的成员现在就可以了解接下来发生了什么。

sentences.en: The story of Sir Robert Napier's Abyssinian expedition and the great battle for Magdala right now.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·纳皮尔爵士的阿比西尼亚远征队的故事以及争夺马格达拉的伟大战役就在眼前。

sentences.en: And we have a special incentive, Dominic, this week because club members will be getting a special bonus on some of the great characters of this story.
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，我们这周有一个特别的激励措施，因为俱乐部成员将获得关于这个故事中几位伟大人物的特别福利。

sentences.en: The hostages, the adventurers, and particularly the mad story of what happened to Teodros' son who improbably ended up as a schoolboy in one of England's great public schools.
sentences.zh: 人质、冒险家，尤其是关于特沃德罗斯儿子的疯狂故事——他出人意料地最终成为了英国一所伟大公学里的男学生。

sentences.en: And not just any school.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是一所普通的学校。

sentences.en: He went to Flashman's old school.
sentences.zh: 他去的是弗lashman（闪曼）的母校。

sentences.en: Rugby.
sentences.zh: 拉格比公学。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太惊人了。

sentences.en: So to hear all that and to hear episode two, if you're not already a member of the Rest of the History Club, you can go to therestishistory.com.
sentences.zh: 所以想听所有这些内容以及第二集，如果你还不是“历史其余部分”俱乐部的成员，你可以访问therestishistory.com。

sentences.en: But for now, thank you, Dominic.
sentences.zh: 但现在，谢谢你，多米尼克。

sentences.en: Goodbye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 拜拜。
